info.title: Health Insurance EKS Health Checker
info.description: Checks health status of the HealthShield EKS cluster including node groups, deployments, and pod restarts in the health-insurance namespace

get.description: Checks the health of the healthshield-eks cluster — cluster status, node group health, unhealthy or scaled-down deployments, and crashing pods in the health-insurance namespace. Use this when the user asks if insurance services are running, if pods are healthy, or for an SRE health check. Default cluster is healthshield-eks and default namespace is health-insurance.

parameters.name: cluster_name
parameters.description: EKS cluster name to check. Defaults to healthshield-eks.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Kubernetes namespace to check deployments and pods in. Defaults to health-insurance.
